IntroHistory.ReferredTo: Referred to Committee on Highways & Transportation.

Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring headlights when wipers are used.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to vehicle headlights; and amending RCW 46.37.020.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.37.020 and 1977 ex.s. c 355 s 2 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Every vehicle upon a highway within this state at any time from ahalf hour after sunset to a half hour before sunrise, at any time whenthe vehicle's windshield wipers are in use, and at any other time when,due to insufficient light or unfavorable atmospheric conditions,persons and vehicles on the highway are not clearly discernible at adistance of one thousand feet ahead shall display lighted headlights,other lights, and illuminating devices as hereinafter respectivelyrequired for different classes of vehicles, subject to exceptions withrespect to parked vehicles, and such stop lights, turn signals, andother signaling devices shall be lighted as prescribed for the use ofsuch devices.
